papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q2(a) magnitude and direction share the final 5-mark placement and remain a joint task. Q4(b)(i) the wedge and particle diagrams receive 5 each; Q4(b)(ii) q receives 10 and p receives 5. Q5(a)(i) and Q5(b)(i) paired speeds share a final 5-mark placement and remain joint tasks. Q7(a) magnitude receives 20 and direction 5. Q7(b) the scheme derives the vertical and horizontal forces for part (ii) before the coefficient for part (i): the forces receive 5 each and the coefficient receives the remaining 15, without double-counting preparation. Q9(a) both densities share the final 5-mark placement. Q10(a)(i) c has its own 5-mark placement; a and b share a final 5 and the two other preparation placements, for 15 jointly. No finite answer-option pools occur.
